items.title: ASOS app pushed 'Snowflake instance compromised' hack message to thousands of shoppers
items.summary: Thousands of ASOS customers received a push notification claiming attackers had 'fully compromised' its Snowflake instance, with a link to a Telegram channel named Xuanye group. ASOS says it is investigating; the company has not confirmed that customer data was accessed.

items.title: South Korea's president says AI appears to have been used in recent bank hacks
items.summary: President Lee Jae Myung said AI models are believed to have been used in recent hacking incidents against South Korean commercial banks that exposed customers' personal information. Police launched a full-scale investigation; banks including Shinhan, KB Kookmin, Hana and Woori were reported affected.

items.title: Atlassian patches critical CVE-2026-21589 (CVSS 9.3) affecting Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket Data Center
items.summary: Atlassian disclosed an unauthenticated arbitrary file access flaw via path traversal affecting eight self-managed Data Center products, including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible and Fisheye. Cloud customers are already patched; self-managed admins should update now. No confirmed exploitation yet.

items.title: Dell urges patching of critical DSU flaw (CVE-2026-86360) that could give attackers root access
items.summary: A path traversal bug in Dell System Update (versions before 2.3.0.0), CVSS 9.6, lets an unauthenticated remote attacker execute arbitrary code with root privileges on PowerEdge servers. Dell advises upgrading immediately as DSU is widely used for BIOS, firmware and software updates.

items.title: Ransomware crews now exploiting critical JetBrains TeamCity flaw CVE-2026-63077
items.summary: CISA confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-63077, a CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated remote-code-execution bug in JetBrains TeamCity used by 30,000+ dev teams. The flaw lets attackers run OS commands as the TeamCity process; JetBrains patched it in July but unpatched servers are being hit two months later.
